integrity: The proof reconstructs the size of the cyclicizer from graph part sizes, forces an index-two cyclic subgroup, and derives inversion conjugation from the fact that every outside element has the same square.
scientific_limitations: The comparison group is assumed finite.
The novelty claim is restricted to dicyclic parameters n that are not powers of two because the generalized quaternion two-group case is already in the foundational literature.
One later 2019 comparison source was inspectable only at abstract level.
title: Non-power-of-two dicyclic groups are determined by their noncyclic graphs
